final_message:
I fixed the bug. The reproducing test now passes, along with the 24 existing tests (25 passed in total).

**Root cause:** `BillingEngine.__init__` in `billing/engine.py` built its context with `dunning_policy and DEFAULT_POLICY`. When no policy was passed, that evaluated to `None`, so the default policy was never applied. When a custom policy was passed, it was silently replaced by the default. A customer with no card hit `record_failure`, which reads `policy["retry_offsets_days"]` and raised the `TypeError`. The fix is `dunning_policy if dunning_policy is not None else DEFAULT_POLICY`.

I wrote `answer.json` as `{"file": "engine.py", "function": "__init__"}`.

I ran the reproducing test from a temporary file and deleted it afterwards, so it isn't in the suite. `git status` doesn't list `answer.json`, which suggests it's gitignored, but I didn't check.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && wc -l *.py && cat ../tests/conftest.py | head -60 && grep -n "def subscribe" -A60 engine.py
cd billing && cat payments.py dunning.py; grep -n "def invoices_for" -A8 engine.py; cd ..; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cat >> tests/test_tmp.py <<'E'
def test_customer_without_card_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_tmp.py 2>&1 | tail -30; grep -n "def default_payment_method" -A15 billing/customers.py

sed -i 's/dunning_policy and DEFAULT_POLICY/dunning_policy if dunning_policy is not None else DEFAULT_POLICY/' billing/engine.py
echo '{"file": "engine.py", "function": "__init__"}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; rm tests/test_tmp.py

cat > tests/test_tmp.py <<'E'
def test_customer_without_card_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; rm tests/test_tmp.py; cat answer.json; git status --short
